l.i: Mente Deum placa, vitulum sine crescat aratro,
Et vera Christum quaerere disce fide.
Sin vitulos offerre libet, ne quaerito longè,
Selneccerus adest, en tibi ter vitulus.

main_text.l: VENERABILI DOMINO, Domino Superintendenti Lipsiæ, Nicolao Selneccero.

page.notes: The engraved or decorative initial "C" of the dedication verse is read as "C" with the following word "Cauillator"; the first letter of the verse is a decorative initial. The initial letters of "Cauillator" and "Quod" are decorative swash capitals. The word "Cauillator" and "Quod" may carry printing ornament; read as printed. Show-through text on the right is not transcribed.
